result: For every complex v=(v0,v1,v2) satisfying |v1|^2+3(|v0|^2+|v2|^2)<=6, the actual normalized projection of the fixed 4x5 grid PPT/SN3 state by K|0,1,2>=|0,1,2>, K|3>=v0|0>+v1|1>+v2|2>, K|4>=|3> has SN<=2. This includes nonzero four-support kernel vectors and parameters |v1|^2>3 not covered by either endpoint Gram certificate. The exact local symmetry transfers the entire sufficient region to the corresponding |4>-tail kernel chart. This remains a proper family, not a universal 4x4 theorem.
state: Use [q]=|q><q|, A=|00>+|11>+|22>, B=|01>+|12>, D=|10>-|21>, C=|02>+|34>, E=|20>+|33>, F=|23>, G=|30>, I=|32>, H0=|04>, and R=[A]+[B]+[D]+3([C]+[E]+[F]+[G]+[I]+[H0]). The original 4x5 PPT/SN3 state and exact source-correction certificates are in frontier-20261028-grid-state-five-projections-v1.json SHA256 9863760e2ca2331164d12e62300f3ad7db5b6a17a3ef424e360d504d541004a9, based on https://arxiv.org/html/2509.07086v1. The projected state is PPT under any local K and has trace 25+6 sum|vj|^2.
five_phase_seed: For z^5=1 take q5_z=zA'+B'-z^2D'-z^3X-z^4v1G'. Its coefficient rows are [z,1,0,0],[-z^2,z,1,0],[-z^3,z^2,z,0],[-z^4v1,-z^3v1,0,0]: row2=z*row1 and row3=-z^3*v1*row0. Therefore SR(q5_z)<=2, and T5=(1/5)sum[q5_z]=[A']+[B']+[D']+[X]+|v1|^2[G'] by phase orthogonality. This is the prior five-phase seed in frontier-20261028-grid-three-head-compressions-v1.json SHA256 6d27bfe9b5caef577097d1131094c853bae46b1b01bc630f09b14312b1d604b5.
new_four_phase_seed: For z^4=1 take q4_z=zA'+B'-z^2*v1*I'-z^3X. Its rows are [z,1,0,0],[0,z,1,0],[-z^3,0,z,0],[0,-z^3*v1,-z^2*v1,0]. Row2=-z^2*row0+z*row1 and row3=-z^2*v1*row1, so SR(q4_z)<=2. Orthogonality yields T4=(1/4)sum[q4_z]=[A']+[B']+[X]+|v1|^2[I']. D' itself has SR2.
interpolation: For any p in [0,1] set T=|v1|^2 and H_p=diag(3,3-pT,3-(1-p)T)-t*t^*. Exactly R_v=p*T5+(1-p)*T4+(1-p)[D']+3([C']+[F']+[H0'])+sum_(j,k)(H_p)_jk |L_j><L_k|, L=(E',G',I'). Any L-combination is supported on Alice rows2,3, and C',F',H0',D' have SR<=2. Thus H_p>=0 is a sufficient all-variable SR2 certificate. If the last two diagonal entries are strictly positive, the condition is 1/3+|v0|^2/(3-pT)+|v2|^2/(3-(1-p)T)<=1; zero diagonal entries require the corresponding v coefficient to vanish and the remaining Schur condition. Endpoints p=1 and p=0 are the old and the new individual phase seeds, respectively.
simple_half_half_domain: For p=1/2 both lower diagonal budgets equal d=3-T/2. If T<6, the Schur condition becomes |v0|^2+|v2|^2<=2-T/3, equivalently T+3(|v0|^2+|v2|^2)<=6. If T=6, the same inequality forces v0=v2=0, when H_(1/2)=diag(2,0,0)>=0. Thus the stated closed domain is valid, including its degenerate boundary.
four_support_entangled_example: Take v0=v2=45/46 and v1=1/2. The kernel has all four coordinates 0,1,2,3 nonzero. U=|v0|^2=|v2|^2=2025/2116 and T=1/4. Both individual endpoint Schur sums are 3037/3036>1, while the p=1/2 sum is 36467/36501<1; hence interpolation strictly improves both. The independent core Cauchy argument in frontier-20261028-grid-three-head-compressions-v1.json gives entanglement since 3(T+U)=3831/1058<4. Therefore R_v/(40187/1058) is an actual 4x4 PPT entangled state of exactly Schmidt number2, not merely a coefficient profile.
large_middle_example: At v=(1/2,2,1/2), T=4 and both endpoint Grams have a negative diagonal entry, but the half-half condition is 4+3(1/4+1/4)=11/2<6. Exact mixed-Gram pivots are [2,5/8,2/5]. This proves PPT/SN<=2 there without claiming entanglement.
reflection: The verified local symmetry in frontier-20261028-grid-mixed-zero-three-compressions-v1.json SHA256 25278f1e460330954c54de872f9468b880fa3f3220dbab6c15954852cb139789 preserves R and sends Bob 0->-2, 2->0, 1->1, 3->-4. Hence it maps the sufficient domain to kernel |4>-w0|0>-w1|1>-w2|2>, where the same condition |w1|^2+3(|w0|^2+|w2|^2)<=6 holds. Any surjective map with the same kernel differs by an invertible output filter.

exact_check.observed: Three exact Gaussian-rational parameter triples, including the two stated examples, checked all five-phase 3x3 minor polynomials as identities in z, each four-phase vector's rank minors, all 256 state entries, exact mixed-Gram PSD and exact actual PT pivots. The first example has Gram pivots [2,1523/1058,391/48736]. The universal claim follows from the written row/phase/Schur proof, not these finite samples.

limits: The displayed quadratic domain and the more general H_p>=0 condition are sufficient, not necessary, and cover only the lambda=0 chart and its reflected counterpart. No generic four-complex-parameter result, 4x4 SN>=3 witness, unrestricted theorem, external/formal review or novelty clearance is claimed.
